game.title: New York Giants at Philadelphia Eagles

lede: New York Giants carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#20 in EPA per play), while Philadelphia Eagles owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#13 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Philadelphia Eagles −1.5 with a fair total of 41.0 — approximately a one-score game, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Philadelphia Eagles pass offence vs New York Giants pass defence, which sits −0.174 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
